#=============================================================================
# ip/crypto/aes128
#
# A single add_ip() call registers the complete flow:
#   lint -> cocotb simulation + SystemVerilog testbench -> synthesis -> timing
#
# rtl/aes_sbox.sv and rtl/aes_inv_sbox.sv are generated by
# scripts/gen_sbox.py; the cocotb model computes its own S-box, so a stale
# table fails the regression.
#=============================================================================
add_ip(
  NAME            aes128
  TOP             aes128
  SOURCES         rtl/aes_sbox.sv rtl/aes_inv_sbox.sv rtl/aes128.sv
  SVTB            tb/tb_aes128.sv
  COCOTB_MODULES  test_aes128
  PARAMS          DECRYPT=1
  CLOCK_PERIOD_NS 10.0
  CLOCK_PORT      clk
  STA_SDC         scripts/aes128.sdc
)
